notes.title: Update V 1.3
notes.content:
What news:

• Optimization + 20%
• The rate of fat zombies is reduced from 500 units to 450 units.
• The health of fat zombies has been reduced from 500 units to 400 units.
• The rise time for fat zombies has been increased from 60 seconds to 120 seconds.
• Added more shotgun cartridge.
• Added more pistol cartridge.
• Changed inventory.
• Increased the time of raising zombies for 20 seconds.
• Increased fanarik range, at minimum settings.

notes.title: Update v 1.201
notes.content:
• Fixed a problem after talking with Emma.
• Fixed a problem with a combination lock near Morse code.
• Fixed some objects.
• Fixed collision on some objects.
• Balancing collisions.
• Increased gun power.
• Added LOD to many objects.
• Balancing shaders.
• Fixed drawing distance.

The next patch will increase the optimization.
